top_opportunities.title: SAM 2 instance masks (Grounding DINO boxes as prompts)
top_opportunities.why: Replaces the depth-band mask that leaked floor/wall into objects (the measured cause of a 7 m sofa). transformers already ships Sam2Model; Apache-2.0 code and weights; no new dependency.
top_opportunities.measure: instance mIoU and boundary F1 once annotated; until then cross-view extent plausibility on the 10-photo room

top_opportunities.title: Human-verified ground truth: CVAT or Label Studio + FiftyOne feeding the Reality Benchmark
top_opportunities.why: Every accuracy metric is blocked by the absence of annotations. Review tooling, not a new benchmark.
top_opportunities.measure: enables precision/recall/mAP; no number exists before it

top_opportunities.title: DINOv2 appearance embeddings in the association resolver
top_opportunities.why: Association is geometry-only, so views of one object split (two rugs) or merge. Code exists and is unreachable; weights are cached.

top_opportunities.title: Small-object tiled pass wired into perception
top_opportunities.why: perception/entities/small_objects.py is unreachable from the API; sockets, switches and handles are not found at full-frame scale.

top_opportunities.title: Open3D outlier removal, robust registration and TSDF/Poisson
top_opportunities.why: MIT, wheel available. Cleans the sparse and dense clouds before plane fitting; TSDF/Poisson are candidates for the mesh stage.
top_opportunities.measure: Chamfer / surface distance vs surveyed room; plane-fit residual

top_opportunities.title: hloc + LightGlue matching for SfM reproducibility
top_opportunities.why: Run-to-run geometry varies (995 vs 1,423 points). Extractor weights licence (SuperPoint) must be resolved first.
top_opportunities.measure: registration rate, reprojection error, run-to-run spread

top_opportunities.title: Cross-view depth consistency (metric depth, one global scale)
top_opportunities.why: Best measured fit to SfM (0.117 vs 0.199) but the model card declares no licence; blocked on a licence read.

top_opportunities.title: Florence-2 as a second-opinion detector (native in transformers)
top_opportunities.why: MIT weights; no remote code now. Only replaces Grounding DINO if it wins on annotated data.

top_opportunities.title: manifold3d for guaranteed-valid mesh booleans / watertight checks
top_opportunities.why: Apache-2.0, wheel available. Protects export validity.
top_opportunities.measure: watertightness, topological validity of exported meshes

top_opportunities.title: IfcOpenShell: validate IFC against real captures
top_opportunities.why: Already integrated (LGPL-3.0); the gap is real-data validation of the semantics, not a new library.
top_opportunities.measure: IFC element completeness vs measured room
